- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` ~L2015
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/action-bar.test.tsx` ~L408
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-capability-gate.test.tsx` ~L12
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkActionCapabilityGate.test.tsx` ~L15
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` L810
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.toolbarCapabilityGate-9782.test.tsx` L14

The last two were found by the at-tier contract review 6505129020 on #27664.

domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

Note for whoever claims this card (from the ADR contract review on #27664, record 6505129020): the file list above misses one console surface that restates the old ADR-0066 D4 api clause. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` (around L810, the `list_toolbar` docblock quoting "enforced with 403 on the platform action route (script/flow/modal + MCP)") and its pin `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.toolbarCapabilityGate-9782.test.tsx` (around L14). Once #27610's ADR text and #27649 land, an api click through the door is enforced at the route too, so read both against the new clause when this card is cut.
